name: Contract Manager
description: Track contracts, monitor renewal dates, store documents, and automate reminders — powered by Commander Tables, Documents, Calendar, and Automations. Replaces Ironclad, Juro, and ContractSafe.

sections.name: Contract Register
sections.purpose: All contracts in a filterable table with status badges, value, counterparty, dates, and type

sections.name: Contract Detail
sections.purpose: Full contract view with document preview, milestones timeline, key dates, and action buttons

sections.name: Renewal Timeline
sections.purpose: Calendar/timeline view of upcoming renewals and milestones synced to Commander Calendar

sections.name: Reminders
sections.purpose: Automated email reminders for renewals, notice periods, and milestone deadlines

sections.name: Dashboard
sections.purpose: Overview: total contracts, active value, expiring soon, by type/department, renewal timeline

design.colorPalette: Trust — teal (#0F766E) primary, white background, green for active, amber for expiring, red for expired
design.typography: Geist sans-serif, tabular figures for values and dates

what_you_build: A contract management app with document storage, renewal tracking, milestones, and automated reminders. Replaces Ironclad, Juro, and ContractSafe.
starter_prompt: I want to build a contract manager using the WaymakerOS Contract Manager blueprint. Use host_blueprint_get with blueprint_id "contract-manager" to get the full blueprint, then guide me through building it.
seo_title: Contract Manager App Template — Build with AI | WaymakerOS
seo_description: Build a custom contract management system with renewal tracking, document storage, milestones, and automated reminders. Replaces Ironclad — built on your data, in your workspace.
